task_description: Create a review-ready wedding itinerary website for guests arriving in New York on October 7, 2026 and attending a Manhattan civil ceremony and Keens Steakhouse lunch on October 9, 2026.

verification.summary: npm run build validated the production HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; all 12 Node tests passed, including the authoritative post-ceremony Keens lunch contract; tests exercise critical itinerary content, current 2026 fare guidance, route guidance, semantic and security contracts, affected touch-target selectors, light-section WCAG AA contrast, two-color focus-indicator contrast across every light and dark site surface, responsive and reduced-motion CSS, and JavaScript parsing/enhancements. Local-server inspection confirmed the lunch content is served. No Dockerfile exists. Commands require unsetting the sandbox's stale NODE_OPTIONS preload.
